text: {"verdict": "approved", "governing_rule": "MP-IMG-001", "reason": "Member is eligible (waiting period satisfied, coverage active), provider is in-network and in good standing, diagnosis M54.16 supports the requested MRI, sufficient imaging benefit remains, and no conflicting authorization exists. Clinical documentation satisfies MP-IMG-001: an 8-week trial of supervised PT plus NSAID/muscle relaxant therapy without improvement (Criterion 1), objective neurologic findings including asymmetric reflex, dermatomal sensory loss, 4/5 motor weakness, and positive straight leg raise (Criterion 2), recent plain radiographs demonstrating L4-L5 disc space narrowing (Criterion 3), and a clear management impact via pending neurosurgical consultation to determine candidacy for decompression (Criterion 4). The MRI lumbar spine without contrast is approved.", "missing_information": []}
